general.overviewDescription: Inspect the UCP posture of each sales channel before exposing it to agents.
general.detailDescription: Configure how this sales channel presents itself to agents before you expose live checkout and order surfaces.
general.activeSalesChannelsDescription: These sales channels are exposed through UCP. Keep this list short and review their transport and capability contract first.
general.inactiveSalesChannelsDescription: Inactive sales channels stay out of the public UCP profile. Activate only the channels agents should actually use.
general.noActiveSalesChannelsMessage: No sales channel is exposed through UCP yet. Activate one first.
general.noSalesChannelsMessage: No sales channels are available for UCP configuration yet.
general.discoveryDisabledTitle: Agentic discovery is not available in this Shopware version
general.discoveryDisabledMessage: UCP still works, but agentic discovery stays disabled until the integration for this Shopware version is available.
general.readOnlyTitle: This user can review but not change UCP settings
general.readOnlyMessage: Viewer-only roles can inspect the sales channel and profile preview, but mutating configuration and signing-key actions stay disabled.
general.exposureCardDescription: Configure whether this sales channel is visible to agents and which profile URL they should follow.
general.activeLabel: Expose this sales channel via UCP
general.capabilitiesCardDescription: Only advertise capabilities that are fully implemented and validated for this sales channel.
general.transportsCardDescription: Choose how agents can connect to this sales channel. Unsupported transports stay visible but disabled.
general.transportRestDescription: Default UCP HTTP API for all supported Shopware versions.
general.transportA2aDescription: Agent-to-agent protocol endpoint for agent platforms that prefer A2A.
general.transportEmbeddedDescription: Embedded cart and checkout entry points for iframe/postMessage flows.
general.transportMcpDescription: Storefront MCP endpoint at '/ucp/mcp' using the sales-channel context without exposing the access key.
general.transportMcpDisabledReason: MCP requires Shopware 6.7 with the Store API MCP endpoint.
general.pendingTransportsMessage: The profile preview shows only transports that are usable on this Shopware version.
general.signaturePolicyWarningTitle: Unsigned agent requests are still accepted
general.signaturePolicyWarningMessage: This sales channel is using the "{policy}" signature policy. Raise it to "strict" before exposing UCP to untrusted agents.
general.allowlistWarningMessage: At runtime, the current sales channel host is used. Add your own hosts before using custom webhook targets or profile fetches.
general.idempotencyRequiredLabel: Require idempotency keys for write requests
general.idempotencyRequiredHelpText: Prevents duplicate cart, checkout, and order mutations during retries.
general.discoveryBudgetDeferredTitle: Discovery budget is deferred in this milestone
general.discoveryBudgetDeferredMessage: The setting is retained for forward compatibility, but the runtime does not consume it until remote profile fetching and discovery-budget enforcement are implemented.
general.keysCardDescription: Keep at least one active signing key per environment. Retire old keys before deleting them.
general.noKeysLabel: No signing keys have been created yet.
general.salesChannelShortcutDescription: Jump from the sales channel into the dedicated UCP view when you need exposure, signing, and profile settings in one place.
